protocol.reward: native reward summed over repeated frames
protocol.score_metric: actual HUD points earned before flag touch; post-flag and remaining-time bonuses excluded
protocol.stall_definition: consecutive decisions without a new maximum x position

media_protocol.format: GIF excerpts plus PNG last frame
media_protocol.timing: approximately game speed; repeated native frames / 60 fps, rounded to GIF centiseconds

limitations: Small fixed-seed evaluation is descriptive, not proof of general skill.
Seeds vary sampled policy actions on the same level and initial state.
Beginning clips cover each completed video trial; ending clips are excerpts.
A stalled maximum does not establish that Mario cannot move or identify a collision.
A non-clearing termination does not identify a death cause; inspect the clip.
